scope: Synthetic policy checks and one dedicated memory helper; no user application trimmed

Only idle fixture qualifies; editor protected
Unknown audio state prevents all trimming
Foreground browser renderer without idle priority protected
Immediate working-set drop is rechecked after settling
Refilled pages are not reported as a lasting RAM reduction
Small actual available-RAM changes are shown in bytes instead of whole percentages
Process working-set sums are distinguished from total RAM reclaimed

Live working-set reduction measured in dedicated helper
All 96 MB of allocated helper data preserved

interpretation: The helper working-set reading remained zero at the follow-up. Allocations were not freed: the helper verified all 96 MB. Fake refilled-memory and negative-overall-delta cases verify honest reporting.
